summary: Iteration 2: Full backend + frontend testing of Customer/Pelanggan management and Hutang/Debt payment feature for Warung Kopi POS. Backend pytest suite (20 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_customers_debt.py) all PASS. Frontend end-to-end debt flow validated: create customer, add product, checkout with payment_method=debt, customer selected from dropdown, transaction confirms with 'Catat Hutang Rp 16.500' label, Pelanggan page shows outstanding debt + Bayar Hutang button, Bayar Lunas pays full debt and removes Bayar Hutang button, Reports page exposes both new KPI cards, History page shows HUTANG red badge. Also confirmed startup no longer auto-seeds the 4 sample categories or 10 sample products (empty DB at fresh start; POS displays 'Tidak ada produk ditemukan').

issues: Native HTML <input type='date'> still in use (carry-over from iter 1).
Header KPI 'Total hutang outstanding' uses same text size/weight as customer count — fine but consider visually separating outstanding number for emphasis.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py customers endpoints: POST /api/customers is allowed for ANY authenticated user (cashier too). Update/delete restricted to admin. Reasonable for cashier UX (allows quick-add during sale) — confirmed in code & test.
server.py pay_debt: amount > current debt rejected, amount <= 0 rejected. Good guards.
server.py delete_customer: blocks delete when debt > 0. Tested.

server.py reports/daily: by_payment dict now hardcodes 'debt': 0 default — good. outstanding_debt + customers_with_debt only counted for role==admin (cashier sees 0). This is by design but cashier UI calling /reports/daily will always see 0 outstanding_debt — that is consistent because cashier doesn't have Reports nav.
POS.jsx confirm-payment-btn correctly disables when method=debt and no customer selected (label switches to 'Catat Hutang' — verified visually 'Catat Hutang Rp 16.500').

Customer.debt is stored as float (MongoDB number). All increments use $inc. Concurrent debt tx + pay-debt could race because not in a transaction — acceptable for MVP, document for production hardening.
Customer phone/address not validated/required — by design. notes also free-text. No XSS sanitisation but React escapes by default.
test_credentials: admin/admin123 (admin), kasir/kasir123 (cashier) — same as iter 1, working.
seed_data_creation: Confirmed sample categories (Kopi/Non-Kopi/Pastry/Makanan) and sample products (Espresso, Cappuccino, etc.) are NO LONGER seeded. Tests create their own TEST_ prefixed category & product (e.g., TEST_UI_Cat2 + TEST_UI_Prod2 @ Rp 15.000). Customer Budi Santoso from earlier manual test persists. UI test created TEST_UI_Cust_A. Cleanup fixture removes all TEST_ prefixed customers/products/categories at end of suite (best-effort).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter-2 features (Customer mgmt + Debt) are working end-to-end. Backend tests: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Key testids used: nav-customers, add-customer-btn, customer-name-input, customer-phone-input, save-customer-btn, customer-card-{id}, pay-debt-{id}, pay-debt-amount-input, pay-debt-method-cash, confirm-pay-debt-btn, history-customer-{id}, debt-customer-select, quick-add-customer-btn, pay-debt-btn (in POS payment dialog uses pattern pay-{method}-btn), confirm-payment-btn, kpi-outstanding-debt, kpi-customers-with-debt. Note: POS payment method buttons follow pattern pay-{cash|transfer|qris|debt}-btn (NOT payment-method-{x}). Note: login redirects to '/' which renders POS via App.js routing, NOT '/pos'.
